field.$description: v0.6 — Layout tokens for the Field composition (label + control + helper + error). The field shell itself uses input.* tokens; this file owns vertical rhythm + label/helper typography roles. v0.8 reduced groupToGroup 20→16 px (peer convergence: Apple HIG 16, Linear ~16, Stripe Elements 12-16); deprecated camelCase keys per kebab naming sweep.

label.$description: v0.8 — Label below stacked over the control. (Was field.gap.labelToControl).

help.$description: v0.8 — Control above the hint or error message. (Was field.gap.controlToHelp).

field.$description: v0.8 — Vertical rhythm between fields in a form. Reduced 20→16 px to converge with Apple HIG / Linear / Stripe. (Was field.gap.groupToGroup = 20 px).

fieldset.$description: v0.8 — Vertical rhythm between fieldsets / form sections. (Was field.gap.fieldsetToFieldset).

labelToControl.$deprecated: Renamed to field.gap.label in v0.8.0. Will be removed in v0.9.0.

controlToHelp.$deprecated: Renamed to field.gap.help in v0.8.0. Will be removed in v0.9.0.

groupToGroup.$deprecated: Renamed to field.gap.field in v0.8.0 + value reduced 20→16 px. Will be removed in v0.9.0.

fieldsetToFieldset.$deprecated: Renamed to field.gap.fieldset in v0.8.0. Will be removed in v0.9.0.

label.$description: Field label. Uppercase mono is reserved for system metadata; field labels stay sentence-case sans-medium.

colorDisabled.$deprecated: Renamed to field.label.color-disabled in v0.8.0. Will be removed in v0.9.0.

optional.$description: The `(optional)` suffix on a label. NN/g preference over the asterisk pattern.

helper.$description: Hint or description shown beneath the control.

colorDisabled.$deprecated: Renamed to field.helper.color-disabled in v0.8.0. Will be removed in v0.9.0.

error.$description: Error message. role=alert; aria-describedby includes its id.
